name: DIGIDRAW Turing 14 2.5K
summary: DIGIDRAW Turing 14 2.5K - D1401 - Pen Tablet Monitor - 13.3-Inch 2.5K IPS Display Featuring an 13.3-inch 2.5K (2560 × 1600) display with a 16:10 golden ratio portable and creative vision Surface AG & AF anti-glare process anti-fingerprint coating
description_html:
13.3-Inch 2.5K IPS Display


Featuring an 13.3-inch 2.5K (2560 × 1600) display with a 16:10 

golden ratio ​portable and creative vision


Surface AG & AF anti-glare process 

 anti-fingerprint coating


True-to-Life Color Performance


16.7M (8bit) color depth, professional color accuracy


99.5% sRGB/ 90% AdobeRGB/ 93% DCI P3 color gamut


Black and white mode, with factory test report.


Designed to meet the exacting color standards of creative professionals.


Precise color matching minimizes inconsistencies across devices, allowing every stroke to feel natural and every creation to appear exactly as intended.

*Only for sRGB and Adobe RGB color gamuts.​



Paper-like 3.0 Technology


 A fully laminated display with AG nano-etched glass and AF coating reduces parallax and glare while enhancing tactile feedback.


16K Pressure Levels

Powered by a new pressure-sensing algorithm, the pen delivers 16,384 levels of sensitivity for exceptional control and precision. Every subtle variation in your stroke is captured instantly, resulting in a refined, natural drawing experience.


With smooth lines and near-zero latency, each movement responds seamlessly—allowing you to focus entirely on your creative flow.



M5 Smart Chip


The M5 dual-button digital pen is powered by the D-M5 independent digital chip and the latest Magic Pen 5.0 technology. By refining pressure sensitivity response and pen body structure, it achieves highly accurate nib position detection and exceptionally smooth, delicate strokes. The M5 delivers a professional-grade drawing experience that closely replicates the feel of a traditional paintbrush.


High Accuracy

Accurately detects the nib position, featuring a central area with an angular offset as low as 0.3mm, ensuring your strokes stay true to your inspiration.


Holder Pen suites

The Pen Holder Suite includes the PH01 pen holder, featuring a complete set of accessories to personalize your drawing experience:


Standard Nibs ×6, Felt Nibs ×2, Medium Grip Sleeves.


Mix and match nibs and grips to achieve your ideal balance of control and comfort


Full Compatibility


Compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, HarmonyOS, and Linux.


Seamlessly integrates with leading creative software, including Photoshop, SAI, CorelDRAW, and more—supporting professional workflows across platforms.


What's Included

Pen Display

M5 Pen

1 x Pen Holder PH01 (Built-in: Standard Nib x6, Felt Nib x 2,

Pen Nib Clip x 1,)

1 x Medium Grip Sleeve

1 x 3in1 Cable

1 x Power Adapter

1 x Cleaning Cloth

1 x Quick Start Guide

description_html_ar:
ارسم على شاشة IPS بدقة 2.5K وبمساحة 13.3 بوصة، واستمتع بتفاصيل الألوان الدقيقة التى تدعم 99.5٪ من معيار sRGB


Surface AG & AF

تتميز الشاشة بصورة واضحة وتفاصيل أكثر حتى في ظل ظروف الإضاءة القوية وذلك بفضل زجاج Anti Glare المضاد للانعكاس، وبصمات الأصابع وملمسهُ الذي يجعلك تحصل على تجربة تشبه الرسم على الورق مع شاشة مقاومة للخدوش


يعمل قلم M5 الرقمي بشريحة D-M5 الرقمية المستقلة وأحدث تقنيات Magic Pen 5.0. من خلال تحسين استجابة حساسية الضغط يدعم 16K مستوى من مستويات الضغط، ويدعم ± ْ60 من حساسية الإمالة التي تساعدك على الرسم بانسيابية أكثر، كما أنه لا يحتاج إلى شحن أو بطارية 


متوافق مع :

Windows 10 (أو أحدث)

macOS 10.12 (أو أحدث)

Android 6.0 (أو أحدث)

Linux (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS)

 

دعم برامج الفن الرقمي الشهيرة مثل:

Photoshop و SAI و CorelDRAW وغيرها، مما يدعم سير العمل الاحترافي.
